```gherkin
Feature: Alarms Configuration

  Scenario: GUI has a control for setting the threshold for HIGH RR alarm
    Given the user is on the alarms configuration page
    When the user clicks on the HIGH RR alarm threshold control
    Then the HIGH RR alarm threshold control is displayed

  Scenario: The control for setting the threshold for HIGH RR alarm allows setting values between 5-30 in increments of 1
    Given the user is on the alarms configuration page
    When the user sets the HIGH RR alarm threshold to 5
    Then the HIGH RR alarm threshold is set to 5
    And the HIGH RR alarm threshold control displays a value of 5
    When the user sets the HIGH RR alarm threshold to 30
    Then the HIGH RR alarm threshold is set to 30
    And the HIGH RR alarm threshold control displays a value of 30
    When the user sets the HIGH RR alarm threshold to 10
    Then the HIGH RR alarm threshold is set to 10
    And the HIGH RR alarm threshold control displays a value of 10

  Scenario: GUI has a control for setting the threshold for LOW RR alarm
    Given the user is on the alarms configuration page
    When the user clicks on the LOW RR alarm threshold control
    Then the LOW RR alarm threshold control is displayed

  Scenario: The control for setting the threshold for LOW RR alarm allows setting values between 5-30 in increments of 1
    Given the user is on the alarms configuration page
    When the user sets the LOW RR alarm threshold to 5
    Then the LOW RR alarm threshold is set to 5
    And the LOW RR alarm threshold control displays a value of 5
    When the user sets the LOW RR alarm threshold to 30
    Then the LOW RR alarm threshold is set to 30
    And the LOW RR alarm threshold control displays a value of 30
    When the user sets the LOW RR alarm threshold to 10
    Then the LOW RR alarm threshold is set to 10
    And the LOW RR alarm threshold control displays a value of 10

  Scenario: GUI has a control for setting the threshold for the apnea alarm
    Given the user is on the alarms configuration page
    When the user clicks on the apnea alarm threshold control
    Then the apnea alarm threshold control is displayed

  Scenario: The control for setting the threshold for the apnea alarm allows setting values between 1-30 seconds in increments of 1s
    Given the user is on the alarms configuration page
    When the user sets the apnea alarm threshold to 1
    Then the apnea alarm threshold is set to 1
    And the apnea alarm threshold control displays a value of 1
    When the user sets the apnea alarm threshold to 30
    Then the apnea alarm threshold is set to 30
    And the apnea alarm threshold control displays a value of 30
    When the user sets the apnea alarm threshold to 10
    Then the apnea alarm threshold is set to 10
    And the apnea alarm threshold control displays a value of 10

  Scenario: Alarm when relief valve opens
    Given the user is on the alarms configuration page
    When the relief valve opens unexpectedly
    Then the system detects the unexpected increase in flow
    And the alarm for relief valve opening is triggered

  Scenario Outline: Setting alarm thresholds
    Given the user is on the alarms configuration page
    When the user sets the <alarm_type> alarm threshold to <threshold>
    Then the <alarm_type> alarm threshold is set to <threshold>
    Examples:
      | alarm_type | threshold |
      | HIGH RR    | 5         |
      | HIGH RR    | 30        |
      | LOW RR     | 5         |
      | LOW RR     | 30        |
      | Apnea      | 1         |
      | Apnea      | 30        |

  Scenario Outline: Setting alarm thresholds at boundaries
    Given the user is on the alarms configuration page
    When the user sets the <alarm_type> alarm threshold to <threshold>
    Then the <alarm_type> alarm threshold is set to <threshold>
    Examples:
      | alarm_type | threshold |
      | HIGH RR    | 5         |
      | HIGH RR    | 30        |
      | LOW RR     | 5         |
      | LOW RR     | 30        |
      | Apnea      | 1         |
      | Apnea      | 30        |

  Scenario Outline: Setting alarm thresholds at invalid values
    Given the user is on the alarms configuration page
    When the user sets the <alarm_type> alarm threshold to <threshold>
    Then the <alarm_type> alarm threshold is not set to <threshold>
    And an error message is displayed
    Examples:
      | alarm_type | threshold |
      | HIGH RR    | 4         |
      | HIGH RR    | 31        |
      | LOW RR     | 4         |
      | LOW RR     | 31        |
      | Apnea      | 0         |
      | Apnea      | 31        |
```
